**Approximating sRGB with CalRGB**

```
[/CalRGB
<<
  /Matrix [ 0.412384 0.212646 0.0193176
  0.35759 0.715164 0.119171
  0.180496 0.0721893 0.950546 ]
  /WhitePoint [ 0.950455 1.0 1.08905 ]
  /BlackPoint [ 0 0 0 ]
  /Gamma [ 2.2 2.2 2.2 ]
>>
]
```

See Annex A.8 in ISO 23504-1:2020 (PDF/R)

# **PDF Function objects**

*m* = number of input values → *n* = number of output values: {*y_{0}, y_{1}, ..., y_{n}*} = *f*(*x_{1}, x_{2}, ..., x_{m}*)

|  Common Key | Description  |
| --- | --- |
|  FunctionType | integer  |
|  Domain | array  |
|  Range | array  |
|  Type | Sampled function  |
|  Type 0 | Sampled function  |
|   | (stream, PDF 1.2, §7.10.2)  |

|  FunctionType | integer | Always required | 0, 2, 3 or 4.  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
|  Domain | array | Always required | 2 × *m* numbers, where Domain_{1} ≤ Domain_{2+1}. Inputs are clipped to nearest boundary.  |
|  Range | array | Required for Type 0 and Type 4. | 2 × *n* numbers, where Range_{2} ≤ Range_{3+1}. Output is clipped to nearest boundary when present.  |
|  |   |   |   |
|  Type 0 | Sampled function | *m*-dimensional lookup table, where each entry has *n* components. |   |
|   | (stream, PDF 1.2, §7.10.2) |  |   |
|   |  | Key | Type  |
|   |  | Size | array  |
|   |  |  | BitsPerSample  |
|   |  | Order | integer  |
|   |  |  | Encode  |
|   |  | Decode | array  |
|  Type 2 | Exponential function | Exponential interpolation of 1 input value to *n* output values: |   |
|   | (dictionary, PDF 1.3, §7.10.3) |  | $$y_j = CO_j + x^k \times (CI_j - CO_j)$$ for 0 ≤ *j* ≤ *n*  |
|   |  | Key | Type  |
|   |  | CD | array  |
|   |  |  | C1  |
|   |  |  | N  |
|  Type 3 | Stitching function | Stitching of subdomains of *k* 1-input functions to produce a single new 1-input function. Since resulting stitching function is a 1-input function, the domain is [Domain_{*i*}. Domain_{*i*} ] |   |
|   |  | Key | Type  |
|   |  | Functions | array  |
|   |  |  | Bounds  |
|   |  |  | Encode  |
|  Type 4 | PostScript calculator function | Stream contains code written in a small subset of PostScript™. Nesting depth for {...} limited to 255. |   |
|   | (stream, PDF 1.3, §7.10.5) |  | Arithmetic  |
|   |  |  | Relational, Boolean, bitwise  |
|   |  |  | Conditional  |
|   |  |  | Stack  |
